notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Folio of Fancies's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, causing each player to draw two cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers, creating a Treasure token for each player who can't pay {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding four mana of any colors.
Repeat.
